scope: Only the four published static navigation glyphs: events, saved, notifications and profile. Parent navigation controls, system containers and spatial interaction have independent pending records.

checks.details: Four 24×24 components with no exposed properties. Original SVG resources are retained unchanged for Apple template asset catalogs and converted by the official Svg2Vector tool for Android. Resource hashes, image-set settings and renderer callsites are checked by coverage:check.

All four silhouettes and effective 24-unit geometry reviewed against Figma in the Web fixture, iPhone destination fixture and Android XR compatibility scene. Tint belongs to the parent; these glyphs are decorative by default. OS-specific touch/focus behavior is owned by the consuming control, not the artwork.

Web library/demo and all four Android packages compile. Apple assets compile for iPhone, iPad and visionOS, and all three destination-item tests execute with the exact resources. Android six-test sample class passes with the artwork fixture.
